v: Ha jun syalkan tik ix uji ayik ayoch winhaj Asuero reyal t'a Persia. 127 makanhil yaj smakb'en winh chi', skot t'a India masanto sk'och t'a Etiopía.
Axo t'a chonhab' Susa, ata' ay spalakio winh rey chi'.

Ayik yoxil ab'il yoch winhaj Asuero chi' reyal, ix yak'an jun niwan wael winh t'a heb' niwak winak ayoch yajalil yet'ok, haton heb' yajalil heb' soldado yik Persia, heb' yik Media, heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' ayoch yajalil t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh chi'.
Nanhal ab'il wal ix yak' jun q'uinh chi' winh, yik sch'oxanel jantak sb'eyumal winh yet' sniwanil yelk'och yopisio winh t'a heb' awtab'il chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch ukexo k'ual q'uinh winh t'a yamaq'uil spalakio. Masanil heb' ayek' t'a chonhab' Susa chi', heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, ix awtaj heb' smasanil.

Te wach' ix aj sb'o b'aj ix och q'uinh chi'. Ha k'apak saksak k'apak yet' k'apak yaax ix och skortinailok. Anhejtona' pax k'apak lino saksak yet' k'apak k'ik' mutz'inak ayoch sch'anhalok pax k'apak kortina chi'. Yamb'il k'apak yuj k'een argolla nab'a plata ayoch t'a juntzanh k'een oy nab'a mármol. Axo xila, a k'een oro yet' k'een plata ayoch t'ay. Axo t'a sat lu'um, a k'een mármol ayem t'ay, ay k'een saksak, ay k'een q'uiq'uik'.
Axo juntzanh waso nab'a oro syuk'lab'ej heb'. Ch'okch'ok yilji junjun waso chi'. Te niwan wino ix el t'a sk'ol winh rey chi' yak'ani.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' tz'ak'an serwil winh to malaj junok mach tz'ak'chaj pural yuk'an wino chi', junjun heb' syal yuk'an heb' jantak snib'ej.
Anhejtona' pax ix reina Vasti, ix schek pax b'ochaj jun niwan wael ix t'a spalakio winh rey chi' yik wach' swa heb' ix ix awtab'il.

Ha wal t'a yukil k'ual q'uinh chi', ix te tzalaj sk'ol winh rey chi' yuj wino. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at ukwanh heb' winh yak'umal serwil winh, heb' winh ayoch yipok sk'ol winh, haton winhaj Mehumán, winhaj Bizta, winhaj Harbona, winhaj Bigta, winhaj Abagta, winhaj Zetar yet' winhaj Carcas.

Ix chekjib'at heb' winh yik b'at yik'ankot ix reina Vasti chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', yujto snib'ej winh sjawi ix yet' skorona kopopi yilji, yik sch'oxanpaxel swach'il yilji ix t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima yet' t'a yichanh heb' niwak yajal, yujto te wach' yilji ix.
Palta maj stak'kotlaj sb'a ix. Ix stenek' ix tas ix b'at yal heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' ix te kot yowal winh rey chi'.

Ix yawtankot ukwanh heb' winh niwak yopisio t'a Media yet' t'a Persia chi' winh, heb' winh yipk'olal yaj yuj winh: Haton winhaj Karsena, winhaj Setar, winhaj Admata, winhaj Tarsis, winhaj Meres, winhaj Marsena yet' winhaj Memukán. Ha heb' winh chi', yojtak ley heb' winh sik'lab'il, yuj chi' t'a heb' winh ix sk'anb'ej winh rey chi' tas tz'aj jun chi' sb'oi.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Icha syal ko ley, naek wet'ok ¿tas yowalil tz'aj ix reina Vasti chi', yujto maj sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il ix, ix b'at yal heb' winh in chekab'? xchi winh.

Ha wal t'a yichanh masanil heb' molan chi', ix yalan winhaj Memukán t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, a ix reina Vasti chi', manhoknhej t'ayach ix och smul ix, palta ix ochpax smul ix t'ayonh a onh niwak yajal onh tik yet' t'a masanil heb' winh winak ay t'a yol a makb'en tik.

Ha tas ix sk'ulej ix chi' ol yab' masanil heb' ix ix, ol sk'ayb'an heb' ix, manhxa ol aj yelk'och heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix t'a yol sat, ol am yalan heb' ix icha tik: Ha winhaj rey Asuero ix awtan ix reina Vasti, palta maj sk'anab'ajejlaj ix sb'ati, xcham heb' ix.

Ha heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh niwak yajal t'a Persia yet' t'a Media tik, ayik ol yab'an heb' ix tas ix yutej sb'a ix reina chi', ol laj yalan heb' ix t'a heb' winh yetb'eyum. Yuj chi' a yuj jun tik ol spatikejel heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, haxo skot yowal heb' winh chi' t'a heb' ix.

Yuj chi' jun mamin rey, tato wach' skan jun tik t'ayach, ak' tz'ib'chaj junok ley yik skan leyal t'a Persia yet' t'a Media tik, to maxtzak yal yek'b'ati: Manhxa b'ak'uinh sjawi ix reina Vasti t'a yichanh winh rey, xchiokab' jun ley chi'. Axo junokxo ix ek'to swach'il t'a yichanh ix chi', a ix tz'ochkan reinail sk'exulok ix.
Ha jun ley chi' yowalil tz'ak'chaj ojtakajel t'a masanil yol a makb'en tik yik wach' masanil heb' ix ix ol sk'anab'ajej wal heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, yalnhej tas animail, xchi winh.
Ha jun ix yal winhaj Memukán chi', ix scha wal sk'ol winh rey chi' yet' masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh, ix och t'a yopisio yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix schekan winh tz'ib'chajb'at t'a junjun makan t'a yol smakb'en chi', t'a sti' junjun chonhab'. Ix yalanb'at winh to ayokab' yelk'och heb' winh winak t'a yol spat, aokab' heb' winh tz'alani tastak sb'oi.
Ix ek' junok tiempoal, ix sikb'i yowal sk'ol winhaj rey Asuero chi'. Ix snaankot winh tas ix sk'ulej ix Vasti chi' yet' pax jun ley ix alchajel yuj ix.
Yuj chi' haxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh t'a yol smakb'en chi', ix yal heb' winh icha tik: --Yowalil saychajkot heb' ix kob'estak t'a winh rey tik, haton heb' ix te wach' yilji.

Sik'okab' winh rey tik junjunok schekab' t'a junjun makan t'a yol smakb'en tik, yik wach' a heb' winh tz'ik'ankot masanil heb' ix kob'estak te wach' yilji. Sjawi heb' ix t'a spalakio winh t'a chonhab' Susa tik, tz'ochkan heb' ix t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hegai, winh stanhwan heb' ix yetb'eyum winh rey tik. Ha winh tz'ak'an serwil heb' ix yik ste b'o yilji heb' ix.

Ha junok ix kob'es ol scha sk'ol winh rey tik, haton ix ol ochkan reinail sk'exulok ix Vasti chi', xchi heb' winh. Ha jun pensar chi', ix scha wal sk'ol winh rey chi', yuj chi' ix schek winh k'ulaj icha chi'.
Ha t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ata' kajan jun winh israel skuchan Mardoqueo yuninal winhaj Jair yinhtilal winhaj Simei. Ha winhaj Simei chi', a winhaj Cis ay yinhtilal winh t'a yinhtilal Benjamín.
Ha heb' smam yicham winh, ik'b'ilkot heb' yuj winhaj rey Nabucodonosor t'a Jerusalén, jawinakkan heb' t'a Babilonia. Junnhej janakkan heb' yet' winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá.

Ha winhaj Mardoqueo chi', ay jun ix yisil jun winh sk'ab'yok winh ayek' yet'ok, haton ix Hadasa, syalelk'ochi Ester, meb'a' ix, yujto chamnak smam snun ix. Axo winhaj Mardoqueo chi' ix ilan q'uib' ix, icha wal yisil winh yaj ix. Te wach' yilji sat ix yet' sniwanil.

Axo yik ix elta jun ley yuj winh rey chi', tzijtum heb' ix kob'estak ix molchaj t'a chonhab' Susa t'a spalakio winh. Ha winhaj Hegai ix ak'chajoch stanhwumalok heb' ix, haton winh stanhwantaxon heb' ix yetb'eyum winh rey chi'. Ayoch ix Ester chi' t'a skal heb' ix.

Te wach' spensar ix ix yiloch winhaj Hegai chi', yuj chi' te wach' ix yutej spensar winh t'a ix. Elanhchamel ix te ak'chaj juntzanh remeyo yik tz'ak'chajoch t'a sniwanil ix yik ste b'o yilji ix, tz'ak'chaj pax wael te wach' t'a ix. Ix ak'chajoch ukwanh heb' ix schekab' winh rey te wach' yik tz'ak'ji serwil ix. Ix ak'chajb'at heb' ix yet' ix Ester chi' t'a jun kuarto te wach' b'aj ay heb' ix yetb'eyum winh rey chi'.
Ha ix Ester chi' malaj jab'ok tas ix yal ix tas inhtilal, ma tas chonhab'il ix, yujto ix cham wal yalan winhaj Mardoqueo chi' t'a ix to max yal-laj ix.
Junjun k'u tzek' winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sat b'aj ayek' heb' ix ix chi', yik syab'an winh tato wach' sk'ol ix Ester chi' yet' tas tz'aj yak'ji serwil ix.

Masanil juntzanh heb' ix kob'estak chi', jun ab'il ix b'ochaj yilji heb' ix. T'a sb'ab'elal wake' ujal sukchajek' akeite yik mirra t'a sniwanil heb' ix. Axo t'a junxo wake' ujal, sukchajek' perfume yet' krema t'a heb' ix ichataxon juntzanh sk'an heb' ix ix. Axo yik ix el yab'ilal sb'ochaj yilji heb' ix chi', junjunal ix ik'jib'at heb' ix yik sway heb' ix yet' winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'och junjun heb' ix t'a winh rey chi'. Ayik tz'elta heb' ix b'aj ayek' heb' ix kob'estak chi', syalnhej sk'anan heb' ix tastak snib'ej yik sb'oan sb'a heb' ix.

Sb'at heb' ix t'a spalakio winh rey chi' t'a yemk'ualil, haxo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, sk'ochkan heb' ix t'a junxo pat b'aj ay heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh rey chi', b'aj ayoch winhaj Saasgaz yilumalok heb' ix yuj winh rey chi'. Majxo k'ochlaj heb' ix t'a winh rey chi', anhej tato ay junok heb' ix te wach', scha sk'ol winh, a jun ix chi' tz'awtaj sb'i, sb'at ix b'ian.

Axo ix aji, ayik ix k'och stzolal t'a yib'anh ix Ester yisilkan winhaj Abihail, sk'ab'yok winhaj Mardoqueo chi', yik b'at way ix yet' winh rey chi', anhej tas ix yal winhaj Hegai stanhwumal heb' ix, anhej ix yik'b'at ix. Te wach' ix Ester chi' t'a yol sat masanil heb' tz'ilan ix.
Ayik slajunhil uj, t'a jun uj skuchan Tebet, ayik yukil ab'il yoch winhaj Asuero reyal, ata' ix ik'chajb'at ix t'a spalakio winh yik sway ix yet' winh.

Yelxo wal te xajan ix Ester chi' yuj winh rey chi'. Malaj junokxo ix te xajan yuj winh. Te niwan swach'k'olal winh ix sch'ox t'a ix t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' ix kob'estak chi'. Yuj chi' ix schek winh ak'chajk'e jun korona t'a sjolom ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankanoch ix winh reinail sk'exulok ix Vasti.

Ix schekan b'ojok jun niwan wael winh yik tz'ik'jichaanh ix Ester chi'. Ix yawtan masanil heb' yajal ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Ix yik'anemta sb'isul k'een tumin winh ayoch t'a yib'anh heb' anima yak'ani. Te tzijtum pax tas ix yak' winh t'a juntzanh nakión ay t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sch'oxanel swach'k'olal winh rey chi'.
Ayik toxo ix k'exchaj b'aj kajan heb' ix kob'estak chi', ayik ayxo och winhaj Mardoqueo t'a yopisio t'a spalakio winh rey,
a ix Ester chi' anheja' max yal-laj ix tas chonhab'il ix, tas yinhtilal ix. Anheja' sk'anab'ajan ix tas syal winhaj Mardoqueo chi', icha ix sk'anab'ajej ix ayik ayek' ix t'a spat winh.

Ha junel, ayik ix k'och stzolal t'a yib'anh winhaj Mardoqueo t'a yopisio t'a palakio winh rey chi', ay chawanh heb' winh stanhwan b'aj ay winh rey chi', haton winhaj Bigtán yet' winhaj Teres. Te aykot yowal heb' winh t'a winh rey chi', wan yalan heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh smilancham winh rey chi'.

Ix yab'an winhaj Mardoqueo tas wan yalan heb' winh chi', haxo winh ix chekan aljok t'a ix reina Ester chi'. Axo ix ix alan t'a winh rey chi' to a winhaj Mardoqueo ix ab'an tas wan yalchaj t'a spatik winh.

Axo ix sk'anb'an winh yab'i, ix cheklaji to yel jun lolonel ix yal winhaj Mardoqueo chi'. Yuj chi' a chawanh heb' winh stanhwumal winh rey chi', ix k'e lokan heb' winh t'a te te'. Ha jun ix uji chi' ix stz'ib'chajkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal winhaj rey Asuero ayik ix yak'an reyal winh.

Ixlajwi yek' juntzanh chi', ix yak'anoch yopisio winhaj Amán yuninal winhaj Hamedata yinhtilal winhaj Agag winh rey chi'. Ix ak'jioch winh sat yajalil t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal t'a yol smakb'en winh rey chi'.

Masanil heb' winh tz'ak'an serwil winh rey chi', yowalil tz'em kuman heb' winh, tz'empax nhojan heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj Amán chi', yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan winh rey chi'. Axo pax winhaj Mardoqueo chi', max sk'anab'ajejlaj jun cheknab'il chi' winh.
Axo juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' tas yuj max sk'anab'ajej jun cheknab'il chi' winh.

Junjun k'u syalan heb' winh t'a winh, palta max schalaj yab' winh tas syal heb' winh chi', yujto toxo ix yal winh t'a heb' winh to israel winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Amán chi' yik syilan heb' winh tato tonhej ol yiloch winh winhaj Amán chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Amán to yel max emlaj kuman winhaj Mardoqueo chi', max empax nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh ayik tzek' winh, ix te kot yowal winh.

Toxo ix yab' winh to israel winhaj Mardoqueo chi', yuj chi' ix snaan winh to manhoknhej winh smiljichamok, palta ix sna winh tas tz'aj satjiel masanil heb' israel ayek' t'a yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi'.

Ha t'a b'ab'el uj skuch Nisán, yik slajchawil ab'il yoch winhaj Asuero reyal, ix och suerte t'a yichanh winhaj Amán yik syil winh tas k'ual, ma tas tiempoal ol elk'och jun tas sna winh chi'. Axo ix aji, ha t'a 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar, ix cheklaj sk'ual.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a masanil chonhab' ay t'a yol a makb'en, ay jun makan anima ch'ok yeli. Ch'ok yel sley heb' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab', max sk'anab'ajej a ley heb'. Manh smojok skajnaj heb' t'a yol a makb'en tik.

Yuj chi' mamin rey, tato scha a k'ool, ak'elta junok ley yik syab' masanil chonhab' to satel juntzanh anima chi'. Tato icha chi' ol wak' junok 7,500 kintal k'een plata b'aj smolchaj k'een tz'ak'ji t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix scha sk'ol winh rey tas ix yal winh chi', yuj chi' ix yik'el skolk'ab' winh b'aj ayoch sello, ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj Amán chi', haton winh ajk'ol t'a heb' israel.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --Ha k'een plata ix al chi', kanokab' k'een t'ayach, haxo heb' anima tzal chi', ik yaj heb', syal tza k'ulej tas nab'il uj t'a yib'anh heb', xchi winh t'a winh.

Ayik 13 yoch b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il chi', ix awtaj masanil heb' winh stz'ib'um winh rey chi' yik stz'ib'an jun ley chi' heb' winh ix yak'elta winhaj Amán chi', yik sb'at t'a masanil heb' yajal t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en winh rey chi'. Ha jun ley chi' ix tz'ib'chaj t'a sti' yet' t'a sletrail junjun chonhab'. Ix och sb'i winh rey chi' t'ay yet' sello winh.

Elanhchamel ix chekjib'at heb' winh chekab' t'a masanil yol smakb'en winh rey chi'. Syalan jun ley chi' to junnhej k'ual ol satjiel masanil heb' israel yet' masanil heb' yuninal heb'. Axo tastak ay t'a heb', ol ik'chajkanek' smasanil. Ha jun k'u ix cheklaj chi', haton t'a 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar.
Ix pukax jun ley chi' t'a masanil smakb'en winh rey chi'. Ix alchajel t'a skal masanil anima yik wach' listaxo yaj heb' anima t'a jun k'u chi'.

Elanhchamel ix pukaxb'at jun ley chi' icha ix aj yalan winh rey chi'. B'ab'el ix alchajel t'a yol chonhab' Susa. Yakb'an wan yuk'an anh winh rey yet' winhaj Amán chi', haxo heb' anima t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix te somchajchaanh heb' yuj jun ley chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Mardoqueo masanil tas ix alchaj chi', ix snik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal, ix yak'anoch pichul yik kusk'olal winh, ix yak'ank'e k'een tik'aq'uil taanh winh t'a sjolom, ix och ijan winh yek' t'a kal chonhab'. Tz'el yaw winh yuj kusk'olal.
Axo yik ix k'och winh t'a sti' spalakio winh rey, maj ochlaj winh t'a yool, yujto max chajiochlaj junok mach yuj winh rey chi' tato ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj.

Anhejtona' t'a masanil chonhab' b'ajtak ix tz'ib'chajb'at jun ley chi', masanil heb' israel ix och t'a kusk'olal. Ayik ix sch'oxanel skusk'olal heb' chi', ix och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Tz'ok' heb', tz'el yaw heb', tzijtum heb' ix sjulek' jichan sb'a t'a skal k'een tik'aq'uil taanh, ix yak'anoch pichul heb' yik kusk'olal.

Ha heb' ix ix tz'ak'an serwil ix reina Ester yet' heb' winh winak stanhwan ix, ix yal heb' yab' ix tas yaj winhaj Mardoqueo chi', yuj chi' ix te kus sk'ol ix, ix yak'anb'at pichul ix t'a winh yik syik'anel pichul yik kusk'olal ayoch chi' yuj winh, palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix scha'a.

Axo ix Ester chi' ix awtankot jun winh schekab' winh rey skuch Hatac, schekab' pax winh ix. Ix schekanb'at winh ix t'a winhaj Mardoqueo yik b'at sk'anb'ej winh tas wan yuji, tas pax yuj icha chi' syutej sb'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix k'och winhaj Hatac chi' b'aj ayek' winhaj Mardoqueo chi' t'a jun parke t'a yichanh sti' spalakio winh rey chi', ix lolon winh yet' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Mardoqueo masanil tastak tz'alchaj chi' t'ay yet' pax jantak sb'isul k'een plata syaltej winhaj Amán yik tz'och b'aj smolchaj k'een stumin winh rey yik wach' satjiel masanil heb' israel yalan winh.

Ix yak'anpax jun skopiail jun ley chi' winh t'a winhaj Hatac chi', yik sch'ox winh t'a ix Ester chi' yik syojtakejel ix yuj tas wan yuji t'a chonhab' Susa chi'. Ix yalanpaxb'at winhaj Mardoqueo chi' to stewi ix t'a winh rey, tope wal syal yek'b'at jun ley chi' t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' ix chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta winhaj Hatac chi', ix ul yalan winh t'a ix Ester chi' masanil tas ix yalkot winhaj Mardoqueo chi'.
Ix schekanxib'at winhaj Hatac chi' ix yik b'at yalxi winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' icha tik:

Masanil mach ayoch schekab'ok winh rey yet' masanil chonhab' ayoch t'a yol smakb'en winh, yojtak heb' to ay jun ley tz'alani tato ay mach tz'och t'a yol sti' b'aj ay winh rey t'a spalakio, tato manh awtab'ilok yuj winh rey chi', b'enhej schami, taxonhej winak ma ix. Anhej b'ian tato syik'k'e sk'okoch winh rey chi', haton jun nab'a oro, sch'oxanelta winh t'ay, a jun chi' max chamlaj. Ha in tik, ayxo jun ujal max in awtaj yuj winh rey chi', xchib'at ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Hatac t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' masanil tas ix yal ix Ester chi'.
Yuj chi' ix spakanxi winh tas ix yal ix chi': Manh a nalaj to yujnhej to ayach ek' t'a spalakio winh rey chi' ol ach kolchajok yakb'an masanil heb' ketchonhab' ol cham heb'.

Tope yuj jun sjawi t'a kib'anh tik jun, yuj chi' ix ach sik'chajoch reinail, yik tzonh a kolani. Palta tato malaj tas ol al tiknaik, b'ajam ol kot junok mach ol onh kolanok, palta a ach tik ol ach satel yet' masanil heb' a k'ab'ok, xchib'at winh.
Ix yalanxib'at ix Ester chi' t'a winh icha tik:

Ixik, molb'ej masanil heb' ketchonhab' kajan t'a chonhab' Susa tik, tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal wuuj, malaj jab'ok tas tze wa''a, malaj pax tas tzeyuk'ej oxeok k'ual oxeok ak'wal. Ol och pax heb' ix tzin ak'an serwil t'a tzek'ojk'olal wet'ok. Ol lajwok chi', ol in b'at wil winh rey chi', wach'chom manh ichokta' yalan ley. Taxonhej tzin cham jun, chamok in okab'i, xchib'at ix.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Mardoqueo chi' masanil tas ix yal ix chi'.

Axo yik ix lajwiek' oxe' k'ual chi', ix sb'oan sb'a ix Ester chi', ix yak'anoch spichul ix yik sreinail. Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och ix t'a jun amak' ay t'a sti' jun yet'tal winh rey chi', b'aj k'ojanem winh t'a sk'ojnub' yik sreyal.
Ayik ix yilanelta winh to ayek' ix t'a stielta chi', ix sch'oxan winh to stzalaj winh yet' ix, ix yak'anelta sk'okoch winh nab'a oro. Ix ochk'och ix, ix och yub'yub' ix t'a snhi' k'een k'okoch chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tas tzach ik'an reina Ester? ¿Tas tza nib'ej? Tato tza nib'ej tza k'an nanhalok in makb'en tik, syal wak'an t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix tak'wi ix icha tik:
--Mamin rey, tato syal a k'ool, ay jun niwan wael ix wak' b'ochajok to tzach kot wael tiknaik yet' winhaj Amán, yujto niwan elk'och t'a yol in sat, xchi ix. Ix yalan winh icha tik:
--Awtejekkot winhaj Amán t'a elanhchamel to sk'anab'ajaj masanil tas snib'ej ix reina Ester tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh rey yet' winhaj Amán t'a jun niwan wael ix sb'o ix Ester chi'.
Ayik wan yuk'an wino heb', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a ix icha tik: --k'an masanil tas tza nib'ej t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayach, wach'chom tza k'an nanhalok in makb'en tik, syal wak'an t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a wal tas tzin nib'ej tzin k'an t'ayach haton tik:

Tato yel xajan in uuj, tato b'ekan a k'ol ak'an tas tzin k'ana', schaokab' a k'ol a kotxi wael k'ik'an yet' winhaj Amán tik. Ol in chek b'ochaj junokxo wael, yujto te niwan elk'och t'a yol in sat. Ato k'ik'an chi' swal t'ayach tas tzin nib'ej, xchi ix.

Ix te tzalaj winhaj Amán ayik ix elta winh b'aj ix och wael chi', palta ayik ix yilan winh to ayek' winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sti' spalakio winh rey chi', ix te kot yowal winh yujto ayik ix ek' winh ta', maj k'elaj linhan winhaj Mardoqueo chi', maj empax nhojan winh.
Ha t'a jun rato chi' maj sch'oxel-laj schichonk'olal winh chi'. Axo yik ix k'och winh t'a spat, ix yawtankot juntzanh heb' yamigo winh, ix yawtanpaxkot ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix Zeres.

Ix och ijan winh yik'anchaanh sb'a, ix yalan jantak sb'eyumal winh t'a heb', tzijtum pax yuninal winh. Ix yalanpax winh to ix sik'chajelta winh yuj winh rey t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet'ok, ix ak'chajoch winh yajalilok juntzanh heb' winh chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh icha tik: --Anhejtona' a innhej ix in awtajb'at wael yet' winh rey t'a jun niwan wael yuj ix reina Ester. Awtab'il in pax wael yet' winh rey chi' k'ik'an t'a junxo niwan wael syak' ix t'a winh rey chi'.
Palta ayik swilanoch jun winh israel skuchan Mardoqueo k'ojanem t'a sti' spalakio winh rey chi', masanil juntzanh tas ay t'ayin tik, manhxa jab'ok yelk'och t'a yol in sat, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal ix yetb'eyum winh chi' yet' heb' yamigo winh chi' icha tik: --Ak' b'ochajem junok te te' jun ch'anhil tz'ajk'e steel. Tza k'anan t'a winh rey chi', haxo k'ik'an q'uinhib'al sk'e t'unhan winhaj Mardoqueo chi' t'a te', yik wach' tzalajk'olal tzach b'at t'a jun niwan wael yet' winh rey chi', manhxa jab'ok tas tza na'a, xchi heb'. Ha jun pensar chi' ix scha sk'ol winhaj Amán chi', ix schekan winh b'ojok jun te te' chi'.
Ha wal t'a jun ak'wal chi', maj ochlaj swayanh winh rey chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh to tz'ik'chajkot juntzanh b'aj tz'ib'ab'il yab'ixal tastak ujinak t'a yol smakb'en winh chi', ix awtaj yab' winh.
Ix ilchaj b'aj syala' to a winhaj Mardoqueo ix alani tas yalnak winhaj Bigtán yet' winhaj Teres, stanhwumal sti' spalakio winh rey chi'. Ix sna heb' winh tas syutej smilancham winhaj rey Asuero chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh ayoch yopisio yuj winh: --¿Tas ak'b'il yet' tas utajnak winhaj Mardoqueo yuj jun tas sk'ulejnak winh tik? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh: --Malaj wal jab'ok tas ak'b'il t'a winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Mach jun ayek' t'a yamaq'uil palakio tik? Ixikek eyila', xchi winh. Ha wal ta' wan sjawi winhaj Amán yik tzul sk'anan winh t'a winh rey chi' to tz'ak'chajk'e lokan winhaj Mardoqueo t'a jun te te' toxo ix schek b'ojok winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi': --Ha winhaj Amán ayeq'ui, xchi heb' winh. --Ix yalan winh rey chi' to tz'awtajoch winh b'aj ayek' winh chi'.

Ix och winhaj Amán chi' b'ian, ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas smoj tz'utaj junok winh winak, tato tzin nib'ej swik'chaanh winh? xchi winh. Ix snaan winhaj Amán chi' t'a spensar icha tik: ¿Machto wal junok ol yik'chaanh winh rey tik? Ha innhej toni, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a wal tas smoj tz'utaj junok winak chi',
to tz'ik'chajkot junok a pichul tza k'an t'a opisio tik yet' nok' a chej tza k'antaxoni. Axo t'a sjolom nok' tz'ak'chajk'e junok yelwanub' icha korona, a sch'oxani to ik nok'.

Axo jun a pichul chi' yet' nok' chej chi' tz'ak'chaj t'a junok heb' winh yajal to niwan yelk'och yopisio tik, syak'anoch a pichul jun winh tza nib'ej tzik'chaanh chi'. Tz'ak'chajk'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' a chej chi', slajwi chi' sketzchaj nok' t'a yalanh winh t'a yoltak kalle yet' t'a parke. Syalan winh ketzjinak nok' chi' icha tik: Ichaton tik tz'aj yik'jichaanh junok winh winak snib'ej winh rey syik'chaanh, xchiokab'i, xchi winhaj Amán chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Amán chi' icha tik: --Ixik t'a elanhchamel, ik'b'at k'apak in pichul chi' yet' nok' in chej chi', icha wal ix aj alan chi', icha wal chi' tzutej a b'oan winhaj Mardoqueo winh israel, haton winh k'ojanem t'a sti' in palakio tik. Malajokab' junok tas ix al chi' to max a k'ulej, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at k'apak pichul chi' winhaj Amán chi' yet' nok' chej chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi'. Ix sketzan nok' chej chi' winh t'a yalanh winh, ix ek' winh t'a yoltak kalle yet' t'a parke, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ichaton tik tz'aj yik'jichaanh junok mach to snib'ej winh rey syik'chaanh, xchi winh.

Ayik ix lajwi yik'jiek' winhaj Mardoqueo chi' yuj winh, ix b'at winh yak'xikan winh t'a sti' spalakio winh rey chi', haxo winh elanhchamel ix paxkan winh t'a spat. Te kusk'olal ix aj winh, ix smakan sat winh yuj q'uixwelal.

Ix yalan winh t'a ix yetb'eyum yet' t'a heb' yamigo masanil tas ix utaj winh chi', yuj chi' ix yal heb' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Mardoqueo chi', israel winh, yuj chi' wan slajwiem opisio tik t'a spatik winh. Manh ol ak'laj ganar winh, palta to a winh ol ach ak'an ganar, xchi heb'.
Manto lajwi yalan heb' icha chi', ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' t'a elanhchamel yik tz'ik'jib'at winhaj Amán chi' t'a jun niwan wael ix schek b'ojok ix Ester chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh rey yet' winhaj Amán chi' t'a jun niwan wael chi'.
Axo yik wan yuk'an wino heb' winh, ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a ix Ester chi' icha tik: --k'an tas tza nib'ej t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayach, wach'chom a nanhalok in makb'en tik tza k'ana', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix Ester chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato wach' in t'a yol a sat, tato scha a k'ool tas tzin k'an t'ayach, anhej wal tas tzin k'an t'ayach to max in a cha miljokchamok, max champaxlaj heb' wetchonhab'.

Yujto a in tik yet' heb' wetchonhab' chi', ix onh chonhchaji yik tzonh satjiel t'a junelnhej. Komonok wal tonhej onh chonhchajb'at chekab'ok, tato icha chi' tekan manh smojok to swik'ek' a tiempo, okxo jun, to ol onh satjokel t'a junelnhej, xchi ix.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj rey Asuero chi' icha tik: --¿Mach jun chi'? ¿B'ajtil ay jun mach snaan jun tzal chi'? xchi winh.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ha winh ajk'ol chuk spensar chi', haton winhaj Amán tik, xchi ix. Ha wal yik ix yab'an jun lolonel winhaj Amán chi', sakxonhej ix aj yilji sat winh yuj xiwelal t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh ix reina Ester chi'.

Ix k'e wan winh rey chi', ix te kot yowal winh, ix elta winh t'a yol pat b'aj wan swa heb' chi'. Ix el winh b'aj ay yamaq'uil spalakio. Palta haxo winhaj Amán chi', ix yilan winh to wan yak'jioch chamel t'a yib'anh winh, ix kannhej winh b'aj ix wa heb' chi', ix tewioch winh t'a ix reina Ester chi' to tz'ak'ji niwank'olal winh yuj ix.

Ayik ix ochxik'och winh rey b'aj ix wa chi', ix yilan winh to kumanem winhaj Amán chi' t'a stz'ey b'aj k'ojanem ix reina chi'. Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tom tza nib'ej tzixtej ix reina t'a wichanh t'a yol in pat tik? xchi winh. Ayik ix yalan juntzanh lolonel winh rey chi', elanhchamel ix makchaj sat winhaj Amán chi' yuj heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan jun winh chekab' skuchan Harbona icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a spat winhaj Amán tik, ix yak' b'ochajem jun te te' winh jun ch'anhil ix ajk'e steel. Ata' ol k'e lokan winhaj Mardoqueo yuj winh yalani, haton winh sk'ulejnak jun tas wach' t'ayach, xchi winh. --Hak'uekk'e lokan winhaj Amán tik t'a jun te te' chi', xchi winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix k'e lokan winhaj Amán chi' t'a te', haton te' ix sb'ok'e winh yuj winhaj Mardoqueo yalani. Icha chi' ix aj sikb'i yowal sk'ol winh rey chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', masanil tas ay t'a winhaj Amán, winh ajk'ol yajoch t'a heb' israel, ix yak' winh rey chi' t'a ix Ester. Axo winhaj Mardoqueo chi', niwan yopisio winh ix ak'ji yuj winh rey chi', yujto toxo ix yal ix Ester chi' to te ayto yuj sb'a ix yet' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anel k'een skolk'ab' winh rey chi', k'een ix ik'chajek' t'a winhaj Amán, ix yak'anoch k'een winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi'. Axo masanil tas ay t'a winhaj Amán ak'b'il t'a ix Ester chi', ix ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Mardoqueo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'ochxi ix Ester t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Ix em kuman ix, ix och ijan ix yoq'ui. Ix tewi ix to tz'ik'jiel yopisio jun ley te chuk ix sb'o winhaj Amán chi'. Ix yalan ix to max elk'och tas syal jun ley chi' t'a heb' israel.
Ix yak'anelta sk'okoch winh rey chi' nab'a oro t'a ix, ix k'e linhan ix t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato wach' in t'a yol a sat, tato wach' tas tzin k'an tik tzab'i, tato t'a wal yel xajan in uuj, komonok tzak' tz'ib'chajb'at junokxo ley yik tz'el yopisio tas syal jun ley ix yak'b'at winhaj Amán yuninal winhaj Hamedata yinhtilal winhaj Agag t'a masanil yol a makb'en b'aj syala' to satjiel masanil heb' wetchonhab'.
Manh ol techaj wuj wilan tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh masanil heb' wetchonhab' yuj tas ol aj ko satjieli, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Asuero chi' t'a ix yet' t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Amán chi' lokanxok'e winh t'a te te', yujto chuk tas ix snachaanh winh t'a spatik heb' eyetchonhab'. Masanil tas ay t'a winh, toxo ix wak' t'ayach.

Ha tiknaik tz'ib'ejb'at icha tas tze na yuj swach'ilok masanil heb' eyetchonhab' chi'. Tzeyak'anoch in b'i yet' in sello t'ay. Yujto a junok ley b'aj ayoch in b'i yet' in sello t'ay, maxtzak yal-laj yeq'ui, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix awtaj heb' winh stz'ib'um winh rey chi', ayik 23 yoch yoxil uj skuch Siván. Masanil tas ix yal winhaj Mardoqueo chi' ix tz'ib'chajb'at t'a masanil heb' israel, t'a heb' winh yajal, t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado, t'a masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a 127 makanhil yaj smakb'en winh rey chi', skotto t'a India masanto sk'och t'a Etiopía. Ix tz'ib'chajb'at t'a sti' yet' t'a sletra junjun chonhab' yet' t'a sti' heb' israel.

Ix ochpax sello winhaj rey Asuero t'ay yik scheklaji to a winh tz'alani. Ha heb' ix b'at spuk jun ley chi', ha t'a yib'anh nok' chej jelan sb'eyi, haton nok' schej winh rey ayek' t'a yet'tal, ata' ix k'e heb'.

Ha t'a jun ley ix yalb'at winh rey chi', yalnhej tas chonhab'il b'aj ayek' heb' israel chi', syal smolb'an sb'a heb' yik skolan sb'a heb'. Tato ay heb' ajk'ol yalnhej tas chonhab'il sk'och t'a heb' yet' syamk'ab' yik owal, syal satanel heb' ajk'ol chi' heb'. Yet' pax yetb'eyum yet' yalyuninal heb' ajk'ol chi' syal satanel heb'. Syik'ankanek' heb' tas ay t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.
Ha juntzanh tik, junnhej k'ual tz'aj sb'o t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', haton t'a jun k'u chekel yajkan t'a 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar.

Ha skopiail jun ley chi', yowalil spukax t'a junjun makanhil yaj smakb'en winh rey chi', yowalil tz'alchajel t'a skal masanil chonhab' yujto ley yaji, yik wach' ha t'a jun k'u chi', masanil heb' israel chi' syak' lista sb'a heb' yik spakan sb'a heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.

Ha heb' winh ix b'at yal jun ley chi', elanhchamel ix chekjib'at heb' winh yuj winh rey chi', ix k'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh nok' schej winh. Ix alchajpaxel jun ley chi' t'a chonhab' Susa chi', b'ab'el chonhab' yaj t'a yol smakb'en winh rey chi'.

Ayik ix elta winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sdespacho winh rey chi', ayoch spichul winh yik yopisio yuj, k'ik'mutz'inak yet' saksak yilji. Ayk'e jun niwan korona nab'a oro t'a sjolom winh, ayoch jun xotil winh nab'a lino k'ik'mutz'inak yilji. Masanil heb' anima ay t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix awajk'e heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Yuj chi' a heb' israel ix el lenaj ix yil heb', ix te tzalaj heb', yujto ix ik'jichaanh heb' ix yab'i.

Ayik ix k'och jun ley chi' t'a masanil lugar yet' t'a junjun chonhab', masanil heb' israel ix te tzalaji. Ix yak'anoch jun q'uinh heb', ix wa heb'. Tzijtum heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' ix yak'och sb'a israelal yet' heb', yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' israel chi'.

Ayik 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar, haton jun k'u chi' chekel yaji yik tz'elk'och tas syal jun ley alb'ilel yuj winh rey chi', haton t'a jun k'ual chi' satjiel heb' israel yuj heb' ajk'ol chi' yalani. Axo ix aji, maj elk'ochlaj icha chi', palta to a heb' ajk'ol chi' ix ak'ji ganar yuj heb' israel chi'.

Ha t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' israel t'a junjun chonhab' b'ajtak ay heb'. Ix syamanoch heb' yak'an owal yet' heb' ix snib'ej satanel heb' chi'. Manhxa junok mach ix stek'b'ej sb'a t'a yichanh heb' israel chi', yujto toxo ix och xiwk'olal t'a skal heb' anima smasanil.
Masanil heb' winh niwak yajal ay t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh rey chi' yet' heb' winh niwak yopisio, ix yak'och sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' israel, yujto ix te xiw heb' winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi',
yujto te niwan yopisio winh t'a spalakio winh rey chi'. Ha sb'inajnakil winh ix te pukax t'a masanil chonhab', yujto t'a junjun k'u ste niwanb'i yopisio winh chi'.
Ix miljicham heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a k'een espada yuj heb' israel chi'. Ix satjiel heb' smasanil, ix sk'ulej heb' israel chi' icha wal tas snib'ej.

Ha t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ay 500 heb' winh winak ix miljicham yuj heb' israel chi', palta malaj wal jab'ok tastak ay t'a heb' winh ix cham chi' ix yik'ek' heb'. Ha t'a skal heb' winh ix cham chi', ix cham heb' winh tik: Winhaj Parsandata, winhaj Dalfón, winhaj Aspata, winhaj Porata, winhaj Adalías, winhaj Aridata, winhaj Parmasta, winhaj Arisai, winhaj Aridai yet' winhaj Waizata. Ha winhaj Amán ajk'ol t'a heb' israel, winh yuninal winhaj Hamedata, a winh ay yuninal heb' winh slajunhwanhil.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ayik ix yab'an winh rey jantak sb'isul heb' anima ix cham t'a chonhab' Susa chi', haton b'aj kajan winh,

ix yalan winh t'a ix reina Ester icha tik: --Ha heb' etchonhab' toxo ix smilcham 500 heb' winh winak heb' yet' lajunhwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Amán t'a chonhab' Susa tik. Okxom pax t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol in makb'en tik, jantak am tas ix uji. Al t'ayin tasto tza nib'ej, ol wak' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix Ester chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato syal a k'ool, tzala' to a k'ik'an sk'ulejxi heb' wetchonhab' t'a chonhab' Susa tik icha tas ix sk'ulej heb' tiknaik icha yalan a ley. Tzalan paxi to sk'e lokan sniwanil lajunhwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Amán chi' t'a te te', xchi ix.
Ix yalan winh rey to sk'ulaj icha chi'. Ix alchajel jun ley chi' t'a masanil yol chonhab' Susa chi'. Ix k'e lokan sniwanil lajunhwanh heb' yuninal winhaj Amán chi'.

Masanil heb' israel kajan t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix smolb'ejxi sb'a heb' ayik 14 yoch uj skuch Adar, ix smilancham 300 xo heb' winh winak heb', palta malaj jab'ok tas ay t'a heb' anima chi' ix yik'ek' heb'.

Masanil heb' israel kajan t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a smakb'en winh rey chi', ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' ayik 13 yoch uj chi', yik skolan sb'a heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'. 75 mil heb' ajk'ol chi' ix smilcham heb', palta malaj jab'ok tas ay t'a heb' ix yik'ek' heb'. Ayik 14 yoch uj chi', ix och waan heb' smilancham heb' anima chi', ix yak'anoch q'uinh heb' yet' niwak wael t'a tzalajk'olal.

Axo heb' israel kajan t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' yik skolan sb'a heb' t'a 13 yoch uj yet' t'a 14, haxo t'a 15 ix och waan heb' smilancham heb' anima chi', ix yak'anoch q'uinh heb' yet' niwak wael t'a tzalajk'olal.
Axo pax heb' israel kajan t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' yet' t'a juntzanh aldea malaj smuroal, ha t'a 14 yoch uj skuch Adar, ata' ix yak'och q'uinh heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, ix sian wael heb' t'ay junjun.

Ix schekan tz'ib'chaj masanil juntzanh tas ix uji tik winhaj Mardoqueo, ix schekan winh to tz'ak'chajb'at t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal winh kajan t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', heb' kajan t'a slak'anil yet' heb' kajan t'a najat.
Ix yalanb'at winh to t'a 14 yet' t'a 15 yoch uj Adar t'a junjun ab'il, yowalil tz'och q'uinh,

yujto ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi' a heb' israel ix satanel heb' yajk'ool. Ha wal t'a jun uj chi', a skusk'olal heb' yet' yok'elk'olal, ix meltzajkanoch t'a tzalajk'olal. Yuj chi' ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix yak'och q'uinh heb' yet' niwak wael, ix laj sian wael heb' t'ay junjun, ix yak'an skolwal heb' t'a heb' meb'a'.
Ha jun ley ix schek tz'ib'chaj winhaj Mardoqueo chi', ix ochkan sb'eyb'alok heb' israel chi'.
Yujto a winhaj Amán ajk'ol t'a heb' israel chi', ix yak'och suerte winh t'a yib'anh heb' tas k'ual satjiel heb' smasanil,

palta yujto ix b'at tewi ix Ester t'a winh rey, yuj chi' ix yak'elta jun ley winh to a masanil chukal ix sna winhaj Amán chi' sk'ulej t'a heb' israel chi', ha t'a yib'anh winh smeltzajkani. Yuj chi' ix ak'jik'e lokan winh yet' heb' yuninal t'a te te'.

Yuj chi' a juntzanh k'ual chi' ix skuchkan Purim. Ha jun lolonel chi' syalelk'ochi, juntzanh tastak sk'an heb' t'a suerteal. Icha syal tas ix tz'ib'ejb'at winhaj Mardoqueo chi' yet' tas ix sk'ulej heb',
a ix sb'eyb'alej heb' israel chi' yet' yinhtilal yet' pax masanil heb' syak'och sb'a israelal. Yowalil syak'och chab' k'ual q'uinh chi' heb' t'a junjun ab'il, icha sk'ual ix aj yalchajkani.

Icha chi' ix ajkani yik snachajkot yuj heb' yinhtilal Israel t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh rey yet' t'a junjun chonhab' to yowalil snakot heb', syak'anoch q'uinh heb' yik Purim t'a sk'ual ix cheklajkan chi' t'a masanil tiempo.

Axo ix reina Ester yisilkan winhaj Abihail yet' winhaj Mardoqueo winh israel, ha t'a sb'i yopisio heb' chi', ix schek heb' tz'ib'chajb'at yuj q'uinh yik Purim chi', yik swach' ak'chajoch yip jun ix schek b'ab'laj tz'ib'chajb'at heb'.
Ix schekan heb' pukchajb'at t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal heb' kajan t'a 127 makan yaj smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi'. Ix ak'jib'at stzatzil sk'ol heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' yuj.

Ixlajwi chi', ix alchaji to yowalil tz'och q'uinh yik Purim t'a sk'ual chekelxo ix ajkani, icha wal ix yutej winhaj Mardoqueo yet' ix reina Ester chi' yalani. Yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' yet' pax yinhtilal heb' yik snachajkot tzek'ojk'olal yet' kusk'olal.
Ha jun cheknab'il ix yak' ix Ester chi', a tz'alani tas tz'aj yoch q'uinh chi'. Ha jun tik ix schek ix tz'ib'chajkani.
Ix yak'och k'een tumin winhaj rey Asuero t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima, haton heb' ay t'a yol smakb'en winh masanto heb' kajan t'a stitak ha' mar, yik syak' k'een heb' t'a winh.

Masanil sjelanil winh rey chi' yet' yopisio yet' yab'ixal tas wal yutejnak winh yak'an niwak opisio t'a winhaj Mardoqueo, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal tastak ujinak t'a yol smakb'en Media yet' Persia.

Ha winhaj Mardoqueo chi', ix ochkan winh schab'il yajalil t'a winhaj rey Asuero chi'. Te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a skal heb' yetisraelal. Te xajan ix ilji winh yuj heb' yetchonhab' chi', yujto ix sayjiek' swach'il heb' yuj winh, ix yak'an wal yip winh yik wach' tzalajk'olal yet' junk'olal tz'aj heb'.
